INSERT INTO kolomoni.user_role (user_id, role_id) SELECT * FROM UNNEST($1::uuid[], $2::integer[]) ON CONFLICT (role_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET user_id = excluded.user_id, role_id = excluded.role_id RETURNING
                    (SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(jsonb_agg_strict(role_id), '[]'::jsonb)
                    FROM kolomoni.user_role
                    WHERE user_id = $3) as "pre_update_roles_array!"
